timestamp_semantics: generated_at_utc is the reproducible SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH selected for this build, not a VCS commit time

builder.name: slotera-release-builder
builder.declared_runtime: Node.js 20+, CPython 3.9+ (PYTHON override, py -3, python3, or python), in-tree deterministic fixed-Huffman DEFLATE writer, and Windows PowerShell 5.1+ or PowerShell 7+ for signed release packaging

runtime.reproducibility: observed host runtime intentionally excluded from the in-archive provenance so identical source + SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH builds remain byte-for-byte reproducible
runtime.contract: Node.js 20+, CPython 3.9+ (PYTHON override, py -3, python3, or python), in-tree deterministic fixed-Huffman DEFLATE writer, and Windows PowerShell 5.1+ or PowerShell 7+ for signed release packaging

vcs.binding: The clean exact tag and commit are verified at QA/build time; the actual commit is recorded in the detached signed attestation to avoid an in-commit self-reference.

build.metadata_command: node tools/release-metadata.mjs prepare (before the release commit); node tools/release-metadata.mjs verify (on the clean exact tag)

transformation_chain.name: source-to-release-working-tree
transformation_chain.latest_change: 1.0.1061 RC67.21: optimize legacy end-date migration for indexed MariaDB range lookup and bounded completion checks
transformation_chain.note: The complete ordered release change history is bound by release_manifest_sha256; only the latest transformation label is repeated here to avoid duplicating the signed manifest.

transformation_chain.name: metadata-and-checksum-generation
transformation_chain.note: Generated metadata is authenticated by checksums and, for official releases, by the detached release attestation.

transformation_chain.name: archive-packaging
transformation_chain.note: Official releases are signed after packaging. The final archive SHA-256 is recorded outside the ZIP in the detached attestation to avoid self-reference.

tree_manifest.semantics: canonical UTF-8 path ordered SHA-256 manifest; its digest is bound by the detached release attestation
